note: Sample catalog for development and for seeding the pilot. Coordinates are approximate and the mood attributes (energy, noise, duration, groupFit) are hand-estimated. Check each entry before the pilot.

activities.title: Harvard Art Museums
activities.description: Three collections under one glass roof, with a calm courtyard to sit in.

activities.title: Museum of Fine Arts
activities.description: A large art museum you can wander for an afternoon, from ancient to contemporary.

activities.title: Sunset walk on the Charles River Esplanade
activities.description: A flat riverside path with docks to sit on and a wide view of the sunset over the water.

activities.title: Fresh Pond loop walk
activities.description: An easy loop around a reservoir, popular with walkers and dogs. Good for clearing your head.

activities.title: Chinatown night food walk
activities.description: Wander a few blocks of bakeries, dumpling shops and noodle spots, trying small things as you go.

activities.title: Trident Booksellers & Cafe
activities.description: A bookshop with a cafe inside: browse, then settle in with a drink.

activities.title: A film at the Brattle Theatre
activities.description: A single-screen repertory cinema showing classics, cult favourites and new independent films.

activities.title: Boston Public Library, Copley Square
activities.description: A grand old library with murals, a quiet reading room and an arcaded courtyard.

activities.title: Arnold Arboretum ramble
activities.description: A big hillside tree collection with winding paths and a skyline view from the top.

activities.title: Institute of Contemporary Art
activities.description: Contemporary art in a building that hangs over the harbour, with steps outside facing the water.

activities.title: Self-guided Freedom Trail walk
activities.description: Follow the red line through downtown past old meeting houses, burying grounds and the harbour.

activities.title: Bow Market
activities.description: A courtyard of small food counters and independent shops. Easy to graze and hang around.

activities.title: Candlepin bowling in Davis Square
activities.description: Old New England style bowling with small balls and thin pins, next to a pizza kitchen.
activities.venueName: Sacco's Bowl Haven at Flatbread Company

activities.title: Mount Auburn Cemetery walk
activities.description: A landscaped garden cemetery with ponds, old trees, birds and a tower with a view.

activities.title: Folk night at Club Passim
activities.description: A small basement listening room for folk and acoustic music, where people come to listen.

activities.title: Castle Island and Pleasure Bay loop
activities.description: A breezy seaside loop around an old fort, with planes overhead and the harbour all around.

activities.title: Skyline hike in the Middlesex Fells
activities.description: Rocky woodland trails north of the city with a stone tower and views back to the skyline.
